title: Exotic diffeomorphisms of reducible $4$-manifolds with odd $b_+$
summary: A diffeomorphism of a $4$-manifold is said to be exotic if it is continuously isotopic to the identity but not smoothly isotopic to the identity. Ruberman constructed the first examples of exotic diffeomorphisms on simply-connected closed $4$-manifolds. His examples were reducible $4$-manifolds that necessarily have even $b_+$ in order that they can be detected by the families Seiberg--Witten or Donaldson invariants.
